shipping.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished supplier shipping-information poster for BEIQIANG footwear Alibaba B2B detail pages. Reference image 1 = our C5 packing poster, STYLE ONLY (navy white orange colors, clean type, compact navy top bar, professional realistic object renders). Reference image 2 = user shipping reference, buyer topic inspiration ONLY; do not copy its composition. New module C6 dedicated to TRANSPORT choices, not packaging.
Portrait canvas roughly 1120x1400. English text only. Premium clean editorial infographic, navy #063266, orange #ff7900, pale cool white background. Header compact, less than 12% image. Exact header text: "BEIQIANG" and "Shipping & Delivery" and smaller "Choose a route around your order needs".
The content fills the page with FOUR distinct procurement options in balanced 2-by-2 generous cards; each has one well-rendered unbranded photographic visual and clear heading/text. Do not repeat large montage or duplicate ship/plane/truck elsewhere.
Card1 "Sea Freight" / "For larger-volume orders." / "Plan around carton volume and sailing schedules." Visual one container vessel at sea.
Card2 "Air Freight" / "For time-sensitive bulk orders." / "Compare freight cost with the required delivery date." Visual one believable commercial cargo aircraft at airport, no brand markings.
Card3 "Express Courier" / "For samples and small shipments." / "Quote using parcel size, weight and destination." Visual courier parcel handled beside a small plain delivery van; NOT same large truck as userreference.
Card4 "Your Appointed Forwarder" / "Use your preferred logistics partner." / "Coordinate pickup and shipment details." Visual concise original logistics diagram: carton -> forwarder -> destination, not second ship or plane, not packaging options showcase.
Bottom narrow light section heading "For a shipping quotation", with clean compact icons and words "Destination", "Quantity", "Packing", "Delivery target". Then one small navy footer exact text: "Freight and trade terms are agreed before ordering."
No added words or typography artifacts. No company history, factory facilities, shoe models, material claims, courier brand logos, world-wide delivery guarantee, DDP guarantee, taxes paid, customs success, EXW/FOB legal definitions, lead-time numbers, free shipping, route map implying actual coverage, shoes, invoices, stock or fake actual shipments. These are logistics illustrations. No watermark. Large readable card body type at mobile width. Avoid giant title taking space, overly busy gradient, repetitive imagery, decorative bullet fluff. Four card roles are the whole message.
reference_roles: user shipping screenshot buyer-topic inspiration only
